findings.title: host.finish skipped on exceptions
findings.message: The control resets nothing and raises on the first failure, but `host.finish()` is only called on the success path. If `host.command` or `host.probes` raises, the host is never finished or cleaned up; the surrounding lease exits but owned process or deadline state may be left unreleased.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the body in try/finally and call host.finish() in the finally block.
findings.evidence: if not passed(result['native']) or result['native']['logs']['stderr']['bytes']:raise ValueError('startup command failure')

findings.title: Rejected run exits with status 0
findings.message: The process always exits 0, even when outcome is REJECT. Callers and wrappers checking the exit code cannot detect a startup failure. Also, the earlier authorization failure raises before the try, giving exit 1, which is inconsistent.
findings.suggestion: After printing, call sys.exit(0 if result['outcome'].startswith('VALID') else 1).
findings.evidence: print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['outcome','error'] if k in result}),flush=True)

finding.title: Hardcoded absolute user path
finding.message: Hardcoded absolute developer-home paths make the committed evidence scripts unusable elsewhere and leak the local username/layout. Also, prepare.py's Q.mkdir() has no exist_ok, so reruns fail.
finding.suggestion: Derive the repo root from the script location or take it as an argument/environment variable.
